chunks: And from the hadith of Yazeed ibn Sinan, who said: Abdul-Hameed ibn Musa narrated to us, who said: Ubaydullah ibn Amr narrated to us, from Abdul-Malik ibn Umayr, from Jabir ibn Samra, who said: I entered with my father to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family), and I heard him saying: 'The Umma will remain holding fast to this until twelve leaders or twelve caliphs will arise.' He said: 'And he lowered his voice with a word, and my father was closer to him than I was.' So when we went out, I asked: 'What was the word he lowered his voice for?' He said: 'He said: All of them are from Quraysh.'
ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about the number and lineage of future leaders?
ai.summary: This hadith, recorded by al-Nu'mani in *Kitab al-Ghayba*, establishes the foundational Shia doctrine of the Twelve Imams by linking the Prophet's prophecy of 'twelve caliphs' directly to the lineage of Quraysh. It serves as a critical bridge between Sunni and Shia traditions, affirming that the political and spiritual leadership of the Ummah is destined to remain within the Prophet's tribe until the end of time.
